Midnight release午夜首賣01 / 08

What the heck is ACOTAR?ACOTAR 到底是什麼？

Romance novels have a reputation: cheap paperbacks nobody admits to reading. So why were people queuing for one at midnight?言情小說的名聲一向不太好，常被當成沒人承認自己在看的廉價平裝書。那為什麼有人半夜排隊，就為了買一本？

Midnight release午夜首賣

On the night of October 26, 2026, bookshops across the United States filled up with people in fairy ears and paper wings. After midnight they could finally buy A Court of Splintered Harmony, book six of Sarah J. Maas’s A Court of Thorns and Roses. Fans call the series ACOTAR, from its initials.2026 年 10 月 26 日晚上，美國各地的書店擠滿了戴著精靈耳朵、背著紙翅膀的人。一過午夜，他們終於買得到莎拉・J・瑪斯《A Court of Thorns and Roses》系列的第六集《A Court of Splintered Harmony》。書迷取書名的字首，把這個系列叫做 ACOTAR。

The publisher, Bloomsbury, says the new book sold about 1.7 million copies in preorders and on its first day, counting print and ebooks in four English-speaking countries. Variety reported that was 600% more than book five sold on its first day in 2021.出版社布魯姆斯伯里說，新書的預購加上首日銷量大約 170 萬本，算的是四個英語國家的紙本和電子書。《綜藝》報導，這比第五集 2021 年首日的銷量多了 600%。

ACOTAR is romantasy: romance plus fantasy. It has fae courts, magic and war, like any fantasy novel. But the love story drives the plot, and most readers expect the couple to end up together.ACOTAR 屬於「浪漫奇幻」：言情小說加上奇幻小說。書裡有精靈宮廷、魔法和戰爭，跟一般奇幻小說一樣。不過推動劇情的是愛情線，大部分讀者也期待主角兩人最後會在一起。

The money錢的事02 / 08

Dragons sell.有龍的愛情，賣翻了。

Three books, three first weeks, more than three million printed copies in U.S. shops alone.三本書，各自上市第一週，光在美國書店就賣出超過三百萬本紙本書。

U.S. romantasy print sales more than tripled in five years美國浪漫奇幻紙本書銷量，五年成長到三倍多
10.8M2020

Print copies sold at U.S. stores that report to Circana BookScan, as reported in November 2026.美國有向 Circana BookScan 回報的書店賣出的紙本書數量，2026 年 11 月公布。

The first week in U.S. shops在美國上市第一週

= 100,000 print copies, at stores that report to Circana BookScan.一本書代表 10 萬本紙本書，統計範圍是有向 Circana BookScan 回報的書店。

In January 2025, Rebecca Yarros’s Onyx Storm, book three of the Fourth Wing series, sold almost 1.3 million print copies in its first week. That made it the fastest-selling novel for adults in BookScan’s 20 years. Count ebooks and audiobooks too, and her publisher says it sold 2.7 million.2025 年 1 月，瑞貝卡・亞羅斯《第四翼》系列第三集《瑪瑙風暴》，上市第一週賣出將近 130 萬本紙本書，成為 BookScan 二十年來賣得最快的成人小說。出版社說，把電子書和有聲書也算進去，總共賣了 270 萬本。

Romance as a whole keeps growing. U.S. shops sold almost 44 million printed romance novels in 2025, 3.9% more than the year before, while fantasy fell 8.7%.整個言情小說市場也還在成長。2025 年美國書店賣出將近 4,400 萬本紙本言情小說，比前一年多 3.9%；奇幻小說則少了 8.7%。

In dollars, Bloomberg put U.S. romantasy sales at $454 million in 2023 and forecast $610 million for 2024. Then the climb slowed. Circana says the genre softened in the second half of 2025, and some readers seem to be drifting toward science fiction.換成金額來看，彭博估計美國浪漫奇幻 2023 年賣了 4.54 億美元，並預估 2024 年會到 6.1 億。之後成長慢了下來。Circana 說，2025 年下半年這個類型的買氣轉弱，有些讀者似乎轉去看科幻小說了。

Not just in America不只在美國

In Britain, A Court of Splintered Harmony sold 188,914 copies in its first five days, a record for adult fantasy there, according to NielsenIQ BookData.在英國，根據 NielsenIQ BookData 的統計，《A Court of Splintered Harmony》上市頭五天賣了 188,914 本，是當地成人奇幻小說的紀錄。

Who’s reading誰在看03 / 08

Found on BookTok.在 BookTok 上看到的。

Plenty of readers now meet their next book in a fifteen-second video.現在很多讀者，是在一支十五秒的影片裡認識下一本書。

POV: it’s 4 a.m. and you just finished book three#BookTok #romantasy♥ 212K
Rating fantasy men by how fast they’d burn down a kingdom for her#BookTok #booktoker♥ 98K
Books where there is ONLY ONE BED#tropes #BookTok♥ 341K

On TikTok, readers film themselves crying at endings, rank their favorite heroes and pile books into stacks. By April 2026, the hashtag #BookTok had more than 77 million posts.在 TikTok 上，讀者會拍自己看結局看到哭，幫書裡的男主角排名，把書疊成一座座小山。到 2026 年 4 月，#BookTok 這個標籤底下已經有超過 7,700 萬則貼文。

Those videos sell books. NielsenIQ BookData linked 11 million book sales in Britain in 2025 to BookTok, about 6% of the whole market. In April 2026, TikTok and the chart company Media Control launched the first official U.K. BookTok bestseller list. Romance and romantasy took most of the places.這些影片真的能賣書。NielsenIQ BookData 統計，2025 年英國有 1,100 萬本書的銷量跟 BookTok 有關，大約占整個市場的 6%。2026 年 4 月，TikTok 和排行榜公司 Media Control 推出英國第一份官方 BookTok 暢銷榜，榜上大多是言情小說和浪漫奇幻。

The posts above are made up; the hashtags are real.上面的貼文是虛構的，標籤是真的。

History來龍去脈04 / 08

An old genre, a new name.老類型，新名字。

Fairy lovers and vampire boyfriends were selling long before anyone said “romantasy”.精靈情人和吸血鬼男友早就很好賣了，只是那時還沒人說「浪漫奇幻」。

  1. 1987

    Emma Bull’s War for the Oaks: a rock singer, a war between fairy courts and a love story. It’s often named as an early classic.艾瑪・布爾的《橡樹之戰》：一位搖滾歌手、精靈宮廷之間的戰爭，再加上一段愛情。常被列為早期經典。

  2. 2005

    Twilight: a teenage girl falls for a vampire.《暮光之城》：一個高中女生愛上了吸血鬼。

  3. 2008

    The word appears, in Germany: a German publisher puts “Romantasy” on the translation of an English-language novel.這個字出現了，而且是在德國：一家德國出版社把「Romantasy」印在一本英文小說的德文譯本上。

  4. 2015

    A Court of Thorns and Roses, book one.《A Court of Thorns and Roses》第一集出版。

  5. 2023

    Fourth Wing, in May: a war college for dragon riders.《第四翼》5 月出版，故事發生在一所龍騎士軍校。

  6. 2024

    “Romantasy” makes Oxford’s Word of the Year shortlist. It loses to “brain rot”.「Romantasy」進入牛津年度代表字決選名單，最後輸給了「brain rot（腦腐）」。

  7. 2025

    Onyx Storm breaks BookScan’s first-week record for an adult novel.《瑪瑙風暴》打破 BookScan 成人小說首週銷量紀錄。

  8. 2026

    Prime Video orders a Fourth Wing series in May. In October, ACOTAR book six comes out.5 月，Prime Video 確定把《第四翼》拍成影集。10 月，ACOTAR 第六集出版。

the word itself this year綠點：這個字本身的大事。紅點：今年。

Love stories with magic in them are as old as fairy tales. The label is the new part. Bloomsbury, Maas’s publisher, has said it coined the word “romantasy” for her books. Oxford’s dictionary team traced it further back, to a German publisher in 2008.帶魔法的愛情故事，跟童話一樣老，新的只有這個標籤。瑪斯的出版社布魯姆斯伯里說過，「romantasy」這個字是他們為她的書發明的。可是牛津字典團隊一路往回查，發現 2008 年一家德國出版社就用過了。

In 2024, Oxford said the word had suddenly gone mainstream, and pointed to BookTok, where readers recommend books to each other. That year it made the shortlist for Word of the Year, alongside “demure”, “lore” and “slop”.2024 年，牛津說這個字突然變成大家都在用的詞，原因之一是讀者在 BookTok 上互相推薦。同一年，它和「demure」「lore」「slop」一起進了年度代表字的決選名單。

Next: the TV show下一步：影集

Amazon has named Esther McGregor and Emilio Sakraya as the leads of its Fourth Wing series. There’s no release date yet.亞馬遜已經公布，《第四翼》影集由艾絲特・麥葛瑞格和艾米里歐・薩克拉亞主演，目前還沒有上線日期。

Tropes套路05 / 08

You know these already.這些妳早就知道了。

A trope is a story pattern readers come back for. A micro-trope is a single scene they wait for.套路是讀者一看再看的故事模式；小套路則是讀者一直在等的某一場戲。

Enemies to lovers is a trope: it shapes the whole book, from the first insult to the last kiss. “Only one bed” is a micro-trope: one scene, usually at an inn, usually in the rain. Readers pick books by trope, and the online bookshop ThriftBooks lets them search that way.「相愛相殺」是一種套路，從第一句嗆聲到最後一個吻，整本書都照著它走。「同床共枕」是小套路，只有一場戲，通常在旅店，通常還下著雨。讀者會照套路挑書，網路書店 ThriftBooks 甚至可以直接用套路搜尋。

Romance readers know what they like and what they don’t. When ThriftBooks asked 2,000 of them in 2025, forbidden romance came out on top.言情小說的讀者很清楚自己愛看什麼、討厭什麼。ThriftBooks 在 2025 年問了 2,000 位讀者，禁忌之戀拿下第一名。

Romance readers’ favorite and least favorite tropes言情小說讀者最愛和最不愛的套路

Forbidden romance禁忌之戀45%
Friends to lovers朋友變戀人44%
Enemies to lovers相愛相殺42%
Love triangles三角戀23%
Office romance辦公室戀情22%
Fake dating假戲真做21%

like it most like it least. 2,000 U.S. romance readers, January 2025; romance in general, not only romantasy.美國 2,000 位言情小說讀者，2025 年 1 月；指整體言情小說，不只浪漫奇幻。

Watch看影片06 / 08

Four trailers, no book.四支預告，沒有這本書。

A romantasy that doesn’t exist. Four moments you’ll recognize anyway.一本不存在的浪漫奇幻小說，四個妳一定認得的橋段。

  1. Enemies to lovers相愛相殺

    “I will never love you.”「我絕對不會愛上你。」

  2. He falls first他先暈船

    Look closely at where he lands.仔細看他最後跌在哪裡。

  3. Only one bed同床共枕

    The inn has one room left.旅店只剩一間房。

  4. “Who did this to you?”霸氣護妻

    He is very, very angry.他非常、非常生氣。

We made up A Crown of Starfire and Silk, then made trailers for it. Each one plays a trope straight, the way a real book trailer would, and then pulls back to show the rest of the picture. They are short and silent apart from the music, so you can read every line.我們虛構了一本《星火與絲綢之冠》，再幫它做了預告。每一支都先照套路認真演，就像真的新書預告，接著鏡頭拉遠，讓妳看到整個畫面。影片很短，只有音樂沒有旁白，每一句字幕都看得清楚。

Fall for someone暈船

To fall for someone is to start loving them. “He fell first” is a trope: he loves her before she loves him. Trailer two takes the words literally.fall for someone 的意思是愛上某人。「他先暈船」是一種套路：男主角比女主角先動心。第二支預告把 fall 照字面演出來。

Play動手玩07 / 08

Build your own romantasy.自己做一本浪漫奇幻。

Pick a heroine, a love interest, a setting, a trope, an obstacle and an ending. The curtain does the rest.選一位女主角、一位男主角、一個場景、一個套路、一個阻礙，再選個結局。剩下的交給布幕。

  1. Place

    Drag a paper cutout onto the stage, or tap it. Shuffle if you can’t decide.把紙偶拖上舞台，或點一下也行。選不出來就按「隨機」。

  2. Listen

    Turn the music on. Every piece you place adds an instrument.打開音樂。每放上一個紙偶，就多一種樂器加入。

  3. Curtain up

    When the stage is full, the curtain falls and rises on your book: a title, a back-cover blurb and a picture to save.六樣都放好之後，布幕會落下再升起，揭曉妳的書：書名、封底文案，還能存成圖片。

Your thoughts?

Read your blurb out loud. Would you buy this book? Which piece would you swap to make it better?把妳的封底文案大聲唸出來。妳會買這本書嗎？換掉哪一樣會更好看？

The other side另一面08 / 08

Is it all one formula?全都是同一套公式嗎？

Critics say the boom has a cost: books made to a recipe, and faster than anyone can write them.批評的人說，這波熱潮是有代價的：照模板做出來的書，而且做得比任何人寫得還快。

enemies to lovers相愛相殺 only one bed同床共枕 a dragon一條龍

Romantasy has a pattern, and its readers like it that way. Critics are less kind. Reviewing Onyx Storm, Kirkus Reviews asked why such a long book left so little room for real character development.浪漫奇幻有一套固定模式，讀者也就是愛這一味。批評的人可沒那麼客氣。書評雜誌《柯克斯書評》評《瑪瑙風暴》時就問：這麼厚的一本書，怎麼留給角色成長的空間這麼少？

Copying is a bigger worry. In January 2025, The New Yorker looked at a lawsuit over Crave, a bestselling vampire romance by Tracy Wolff. Lynne Freeman, an unpublished writer, says the series copied her manuscript. Wolff and her publisher deny it. The case is hard partly because the genre shares so many tropes, and copyright protects how an idea is written, not the idea itself.抄襲是更大的隱憂。2025 年 1 月，《紐約客》深入報導了一場官司，主角是崔西・沃爾夫的暢銷吸血鬼言情小說《Crave》。還沒出過書的作家琳恩・佛里曼指控這個系列抄了她的手稿，沃爾夫和出版社都否認。這個案子難判，部分原因就是這類小說共用太多套路，而著作權保護的是點子寫出來的樣子，不是點子本身。

Then there’s AI. In May 2025, readers found a chatbot prompt left in the middle of a self-published fantasy romance, Lena McDonald’s Darkhollow Academy: Year 2. It asked the AI to rewrite a passage in the style of another author, J. Bree. Two other self-published authors were caught the same way that month.還有 AI 的問題。2025 年 5 月，讀者在蕾娜・麥唐諾自費出版的奇幻言情小說《Darkhollow Academy: Year 2》裡，發現一段忘了刪掉的 AI 指令，要 AI 用另一位作家 J・布里的風格改寫段落。同一個月，還有兩位自費出版的作家也被抓到一樣的事。

Spot the pattern找出規律

  • A Court of Thorns and Roses
  • A Court of Mist and Fury
  • A Court of Wings and Ruin
  • A Court of Frost and Starlight
  • A Crown of Starfire and Silkours, page 6我們的，第 6 頁

“A ___ of ___ and ___” is everywhere now. The theater on page 7 builds its titles the same way.「A ___ of ___ and ___」的書名現在到處都是。第 7 頁的紙劇場也是用這個公式取書名。

Detective stories, K-dramas and Harlequin romances all run on formulas, and readers still fall hardest for the ones that surprise them.偵探小說、韓劇和禾林羅曼史都有公式，讀者最愛的，還是那些讓人意外的作品。

Your thoughts?

Name a story you love even though you could guess the ending. What kept you reading?說一個妳明明猜得到結局、卻還是很愛的故事。是什麼讓妳一直看下去？

Before you goLENS · 04

Things to ponder.想一想

Over a cup of tea, on your own or with someone who disagrees.泡杯茶，自己想想，或找個意見不同的人聊聊。

  1. Romance readers often get teased for what they read. Why do some kinds of books get less respect than others?看言情小說的人常被取笑。為什麼有些類型的書，就是比較不被尊重？

  2. If a book is built from tropes you love, does it matter that you can guess the ending?如果一本書全是妳愛的套路，猜得到結局還重要嗎？

  3. Should a novel written with help from AI say so on the cover?用 AI 幫忙寫的小說，應該在封面上註明嗎？

  4. In Taiwan, 《第四翼》 carries an 18+ label. Who should decide what age a book is for: publishers, shops, parents or readers?在台灣，《第四翼》標示了 18 禁。一本書適合幾歲看，該由誰決定？出版社、書店、父母，還是讀者自己？

How you count changes the record怎麼算，紀錄就跟著變

Print, at BookScan stores紙本，BookScan 統計的書店1.3M
Every format, says the publisher所有版本，出版社說的2.7M

Onyx Storm’s first week, counted two ways. Both numbers are true; they just count different things. When you see a sales record, ask what was counted.同樣是《瑪瑙風暴》上市第一週，算法不同，數字就不同。兩個數字都沒錯，只是算的東西不一樣。下次看到銷售紀錄，先問問算的是什麼。

About this issue

LENS is an InkQuest magazine of contemporary topics in short, graphic pages. Issue 04, November 2026. Written and edited by Wen-Hung Fang. Illustrations and the toy theater’s paper cutouts drawn in code with vex. Type set in Fraunces and DM Sans (SIL Open Font License). The book videos on page 3 are made up.
